title: Datasets
description: model/datasets.json: named, saved semantic queries at a defined grain (glossary "Dataset", SE-1), reused by reports, tools, flows and ML. `$defs.query` is the semantic query format (glossary "Semantic query") every consumer sends to the semantic engine: action `semantic_query` (REST: POST /api/actions/semantic_query with the query plus `project`, SE-9). Time is the date table: group by and filter on calendar.year/.quarter/.month/.week (ISO week, with .week_year)/.day; YTD and the other time functions are measures. Result columns: the dimensions, `grouping_id` when totals are asked (GROUPING_ID bits in dimension order, 0 = detail row), then the measure IDs. Row order: `order_by`, then grouping_id (detail rows before totals), then the dimensions ascending; NULLs last. Results are cached per query and data snapshot (SE-7).

owner.description: User ID of the person who created it; with the project Owners, the one who may share it (SH-1)

sharing.description: SH-1 (D-51): view-only access for accounts with no role in the project. Changed with action set_sharing; project members always see it

users.description: User IDs of named recipients (their tenant must match the project, checked when they read)

workspace.description: Every account of the project's tenant (platform project: every platform account)

dimensions.description: table.column to group by: the grain

totals.description: Extra grouping sets, each a subset of the dimensions; [] is the grand total

field.description: A dimension, measure ID or grouping_id of this query
